headline: Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands calls for shareholder voting via postal ballot
hook: Postal ballot notice issued to shareholders
summary: Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands has issued a notice of postal ballot dated August 1, 2026. Shareholders will vote on resolutions through remote e-voting as outlined in the regulatory filing. The notice details the procedures and timelines for casting votes on corporate matters. Retail investors holding shares in the company should review the proposal details and participate in the e-voting process.
whats_next: Remote e-voting results and shareholder meeting outcome
why_it_matters: Your voting rights as a shareholder are now active.
